subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be an opt-in queue mode/policy rather than a change to the existing `steer` default?
rationale: The requested behavior changes active-run interruption, partial-output preservation, tool-result pairing, transcript/session state, and compatibility expectations; source inspection can prove it is not implemented but cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving current boundary steering as the default.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Decide that current steer remains a model-boundary feature and close or narrow the broad soft-steer request after the active-run ingress tracker resolves.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing `steer` more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for workflows that depend on current boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new mode or explicit policy for abort/capture/inject/resume while preserving current boundary steering as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed the issue as a product/runtime lifecycle decision and have adjacent reply/queue ownership history.
